item_name: Rothco Midnight Camo Medium Transport Pack
item_short_desc: Gear up with our Midnight Camo Medium Transport Pack, featuring a main compartment with a zippered pouch and mesh pocket, and 3 additional zippered storage compartments, all equipped with large two-way zippers for full access to your tactical gear and outdoor supplies. The tactical backpack has a 25L capacity and measures 17 inch x 10 inch x 9 inch, providing ample storage space for EDC essentials. The military backpack is great for going to the range, trekking out into the great outdoors, or stocking up as a bug out bag.
description: Gear up with our Midnight Camo Medium Transport Pack, featuring a main compartment with a zippered pouch and mesh pocket, and 3 additional zippered storage compartments, all equipped with large two-way zippers for full access to your tactical gear and outdoor supplies. The tactical backpack has a 25L capacity and measures 17 inch x 10 inch x 9 inch, providing ample storage space for EDC essentials. The military backpack is great for going to the range, trekking out into the great outdoors, or stocking up as a bug out bag. Inspired by stealth operations that require zero visibility to the opposition, Rothco has reinvented the classic Woodland Camouflage Pattern as well as our bestselling Black Camouflage Pattern to bring you the Midnight Camo Collection. The subdued color combinations offer a true stealth, sharp and sleek appearance whether on mission or off. Utility at the Forefront: These MOLLE compatible backpacks include d-rings and PALS webbing on the outside for mounting and securing additional tactical gear. The large capacity backpack features a rear hook & loop compartment designed for storing a hydration system (not included). Rugged Construction: Engineered with polypropylene webbing and 600D polyester, these medium transport packs are built tough, withstanding rigorous activities while in the field. In addition, the storage compartments feature heavy-duty zippers and water-repellent lining. Versatile Carry Options: These tactical bags feature breathable mesh padding on the back and adjustable shoulder straps for a more comfortable carry. The shoulder straps are also adjustable, allowing you to adjust the backpack when needed. The top grab handle provides quick and easy handling for when you are on the go.
